<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>AR Studioss — OS</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  :root {
    --bg: #050d0a; --bg-2: #0a1610; --surface: #0d1f18; --surface-2: #122a20;
    --border: #1c382b; --border-bright: #285441;
    --text: #e8fbf0; --text-dim: #9bbfa9; --text-muted: #5a7868;
    --green: #5EE7B0; --green-bright: #7CF2C0; --green-deep: #2d8060;
    --gold: #ffd700; --silver: #c0c0c0; --bronze: #cd7f32;
    --amber: #ffb547; --blue: #4a9eff; --red: #ff5252;
    /* Premium design tokens */
    --radius-xs: 6px;
    --radius-sm: 10px;
    --radius-md: 12px;
    --radius-lg: 16px;
    --radius-xl: 20px;
    /* SF Pro system stack — Display for headings, Text for body/UI */
    --font-display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    --font-ui: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    --shadow-md: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    --shadow-lg: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
  }
  body {
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    font-feature-settings: 'ss01', 'cv01', 'cv02', 'cv11';
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at top right, rgba(94,231,176,0.1), transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at bottom left, rgba(94,231,176,0.05), transparent 50%), var(--bg);
    color: var(--text); min-height: 100vh; padding: 20px; background-attachment: fixed;
  }
  .container { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .header {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 20px; padding: 14px 22px;
    background: rgba(13,31,24,0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 100px;
  }
  .logo { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .logo-mark {
    width: 30px; height: 30px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-bright), var(--green));
    border-radius: 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    color: #052e20; font-weight: 900; font-size: 15px;
  }
  .header-right { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
  .user-badge {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); padding: 8px 14px;
    background: rgba(94,231,176,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(94,231,176,0.15);
    border-radius: 100px; font-weight: 600;
  }
  .btn {
    padding: 9px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; font-family: inherit; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-bright), var(--green));
    color: #052e20;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .btn-secondary { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.06); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.12); border-color: var(--border-bright); }
  .btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text); }
  .btn-sm { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 12px; }
  .login-screen { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: calc(100vh - 40px); }
  .login-card {
    background: rgba(13,31,24,0.6);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
    padding: 36px 32px;
    width: 100%; max-width: 400px;
  }
  .login-brand { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 28px; }
  .login-brand .logo-mark { width: 56px; height: 56px; margin: 0 auto 14px; font-size: 24px; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .login-brand h2 {
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-size: 30px;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: -0.015em;
    line-height: 1.1;
    color: var(--text);
  }
  .login-brand p {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 11px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .form-group { margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .form-group label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .form-group input, .form-group select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 11px 14px;
    background: rgba(5,13,10,0.5);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
    transition: border-color 0.2s var(--ease-out), background 0.2s var(--ease-out);
  }
  .form-group input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 0.5; }
  .form-group input:focus, .form-group select:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--green-deep);
    background: rgba(5,13,10,0.7);
  }
  .checkbox-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-dim); cursor: pointer; }
  .checkbox-row input { width: auto; accent-color: var(--green); cursor: pointer; }
  .role-tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    background: rgba(5,13,10,0.5);
    padding: 4px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .role-tab {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 9px 4px;
    text-align: center;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    transition: color 0.2s var(--ease-out), background 0.2s var(--ease-out);
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }
  .role-tab:hover { color: var(--text); }
  .role-tab.active {
    background: var(--text);
    color: #052e20;
    font-weight: 600;
  }
  .error-msg { color: var(--red); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 8px; display: none; }
  .error-msg.show { display: block; }
  /* === NAV TABS (CRM page) — premium squared style === */
  .nav-tabs {
    display: flex; gap: 2px; margin-bottom: 24px;
    background: rgba(13,31,24,0.4);
    padding: 4px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    width: fit-content;
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  }
  .nav-tab {
    padding: 9px 18px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted);
    transition: color 0.2s var(--ease-out), background 0.2s var(--ease-out);
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }
  .nav-tab:hover { color: var(--text); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.04); }
  .nav-tab.active {
    background: var(--text);
    color: #052e20;
    font-weight: 600;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1) inset, 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  /* === SECTION HEADER === */
  .section-title {
    font-family: var(--font-display);
    font-size: 34px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    line-height: 1.05;
    color: var(--text);
  }
  .section-sub {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-top: 6px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* === TOOLBAR — premium control bar === */
  .toolbar {
    display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    padding: 8px;
    background: rgba(13,31,24,0.4);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  }
  .toolbar-group {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
    padding: 0 4px 0 10px;
    background: rgba(5,13,10,0.5);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    transition: border-color 0.2s var(--ease-out), background 0.2s var(--ease-out);
  }
  .toolbar-group:hover { border-color: var(--border-bright); background: rgba(5,13,10,0.7); }
  .toolbar-group:focus-within { border-color: var(--green-deep); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.04); }
  .toolbar-group .toolbar-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    white-space: nowrap;
    user-select: none;
  }
  /* Custom select with proper arrow inside */
  .tb-select {
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -moz-appearance: none;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='10' height='10' viewBox='0 0 10 10'><path d='M2 4l3 3 3-3' stroke='%239bbfa9' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/></svg>");
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-position: right 10px center;
    padding: 9px 28px 9px 8px;
    background-color: transparent;
    border: none;
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-width: 100px;
  }
  .tb-select:focus { outline: none; }
  .tb-select option { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }
  /* Standalone toolbar button (for + Add Column etc.) */
  .toolbar .btn-tb {
    padding: 9px 14px;
    background: rgba(94,231,176,0.06);
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    transition: all 0.2s var(--ease-out);
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  }
  .toolbar .btn-tb:hover {
    background: rgba(94,231,176,0.12);
    border-color: var(--border-bright);
    color: var(--green);
  }

  /* === TABLE (CRM) === */
  .table-wrap {
    background: rgba(13,31,24,0.4);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    overflow-x: auto;
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  }
  table.crm { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; min-width: 900px; }
  table.crm thead th {
    background: transparent;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    text-align: left;
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    font-weight: 600;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  table.crm thead th .col-menu {
    opacity: 0; margin-left: 6px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-muted);
    font-size: 12px; transition: opacity 0.15s;
  }
  table.crm thead th:hover .col-menu { opacity: 0.7; }
  table.crm thead th .col-menu:hover { opacity: 1; color: var(--red); }
  table.crm tbody td {
    padding: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,56,43,0.4);
    font-size: 13px;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }
  table.crm tbody tr { transition: background 0.15s var(--ease-out); }
  table.crm tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.025); }
  table.crm tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  .cell {
    padding: 14px 16px;
    min-height: 48px;
    cursor: text;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-width: 80px;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }
  .cell-input {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    background: rgba(94,231,176,0.05);
    border: 1px solid var(--green);
    border-radius: 0;
    color: var(--text);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
    outline: none;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }

  .add-row-bar {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    transition: all 0.15s var(--ease-out);
    letter-spacing: -0.005em;
  }
  .add-row-bar:hover { color: var(--green); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.04); }
  .page { display: none; }
  .page.active { display: block; }
  .section-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
  .cell-link { color: var(--green); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; max-width: 180px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .cell-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .links-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
  .links-cell { align-items: flex-start; }
  .cell-textarea { resize: vertical; min-height: 60px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre; font-family: inherit; }
  .date-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .dl-ring { flex-shrink: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; }
  .dl-ring svg { display: block; }

  /* Client CRM */
  .client-section-header { display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 4px;margin-bottom:2px; }
  .client-avatar { width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--green-deep),var(--green));color:#052e20;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0; }

  /* Client view of their own CRM */
  .client-row { border-bottom:1px solid rgba(28,56,43,0.4); }
  .row-num { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; min-width: 28px; opacity: 0.5; }
  .shadow-row td { padding: 10px 14px !important; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.3); border-top: 1px dashed rgba(28,56,43,0.5); }
  .shadow-row .shadow-totals { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; }
  .shadow-row .shadow-totals span { margin-right: 14px; }
  .shadow-row .shadow-totals .val-done { color: var(--green); }
  .shadow-row .shadow-totals .val-pipe { opacity: 0.5; }
  .shadow-row .shadow-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; }
  .shadow-row .shadow-actions button { font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 12px; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed rgba(28,56,43,0.6); color: var(--text-muted); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-weight: 500; }
  .shadow-row .shadow-actions button:hover { border-color: var(--green-deep); color: var(--green); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.06); }
  .cell-text-line { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.4; padding: 1px 0; }

  /* Team Pulse — collapsed teammate view for editors */
  .pulse-toggle {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 9px 16px; cursor: pointer;
    background: rgba(13,31,24,0.4);
    border: 1px dashed rgba(28,56,43,0.7);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: all 0.2s var(--ease-out);
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
  }
  .pulse-toggle:hover { color: var(--text); border-color: var(--green-deep); background: rgba(13,31,24,0.6); }
  .pulse-toggle .pulse-arrow { transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease-out); display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; }
  .pulse-toggle.open .pulse-arrow { transform: rotate(180deg); }
  .pulse-panel {
    margin-top: 12px; padding: 20px 22px;
    background: rgba(13,31,24,0.3);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }
  .pulse-header {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 16px; padding-bottom: 12px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,56,43,0.5);
  }
  .pulse-header-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .pulse-header-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-left: auto; }
  .pulse-member {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px;
    padding: 14px 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(28,56,43,0.4);
  }
  .pulse-member:last-child { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 4px; }
  .pulse-member-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .pulse-member-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-display); }
  .pulse-member-stats { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; }
  .pulse-member-stats .pts-done { color: var(--green); font-weight: 600; }
  .pulse-member-stats .pts-pipe { opacity: 0.55; }
  .pulse-projects { flex: 1; }
  .pulse-project { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 5px 0; font-size: 12px; }
  .pulse-project-name { flex: 1; color: var(--text-muted); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .pulse-project-name a { color: var(--green); text-decoration: none; }
  .pulse-project-name a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  .pulse-project-pts { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; min-width: 50px; text-align: right; }
  .pulse-project-pts.is-done { color: var(--green); }
  .pulse-empty { text-align: center; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; padding: 14px; font-style: italic; }

  /* Competition banner */
  .pulse-compete {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
    padding: 16px 20px; margin-bottom: 16px;
    background: rgba(5,13,10,0.5);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    position: relative;
  }
  .pulse-compete.lead-strong { border-color: rgba(255,215,0,0.4); background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.06), rgba(5,13,10,0.5)); }
  .pulse-compete.lead-mid { border-color: rgba(94,231,176,0.35); background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(94,231,176,0.05), rgba(5,13,10,0.5)); }
  .pulse-compete.behind { border-color: rgba(255,147,71,0.35); background: linear-gradient(100deg, rgba(255,147,71,0.05), rgba(5,13,10,0.5)); }
  .pulse-compete.tied { border-color: rgba(74,158,255,0.35); }
  .pulse-compete .cmp-emoji { font-size: 30px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .pulse-compete-msg { flex: 1; }
  .pulse-compete-msg .cmp-headline { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.3; }
  .pulse-compete-msg .cmp-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 3px; }
  .cmp-gap-bar { margin-top: 10px; height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 100px; overflow: hidden; }
  .cmp-gap-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 100px; transition: width 0.6s var(--ease-out); }

  /* Free-floating robot mascot */
  #floatRobot {
    position: fixed; width: 72px; height: 86px; z-index: 200;
    pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
    will-change: transform; left: 0; top: 0;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35));
    image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast;
  }
  #floatRobot svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
  #floatRobot .rb-hover { animation: rbBob 3.2s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 50% 50%; }
  @keyframes rbBob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-0.5deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(0.5deg); } }
  #floatRobot .rb-flame { transform-origin: 50% 0%; animation: rbFlame 0.28s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  @keyframes rbFlame { 0% { transform: scaleY(0.85) scaleX(1.02); opacity:0.85; } 100% { transform: scaleY(1.18) scaleX(0.9); opacity:1; } }
  #floatRobot .rb-flame2 { transform-origin: 50% 0%; animation: rbFlame2 0.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  @keyframes rbFlame2 { 0% { transform: scaleY(1.05) scaleX(0.85); opacity:0.7; } 100% { transform: scaleY(0.8) scaleX(1.0); opacity:0.92; } }
  #floatRobot .rb-antenna-l, #adminRobot .rb-antenna-l { transform-origin: 48px 16px; animation: rbAnt 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes rbAnt { 0%,100%{transform:rotate(-4deg)} 50%{transform:rotate(4deg)} }
  #floatRobot .rb-arm-l, #adminRobot .rb-arm-l { transform-origin: 16px 52px; animation: rbArmIdle 3.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
  #floatRobot .rb-arm-r, #adminRobot .rb-arm-r { transform-origin: 80px 52px; animation: rbArmIdle 3.4s ease-in-out infinite reverse; }
  @keyframes rbArmIdle { 0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg)} 50%{transform:rotate(6deg)} }
  #floatRobot.waving .rb-arm-r, #adminRobot.waving .rb-arm-r { animation: rbWave 0.5s ease-in-out 3; }
  @keyframes rbWave { 0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg)} 50%{transform:rotate(-55deg)} }
  #floatRobot .rb-eye { animation: rbBlink 4s infinite; transform-origin: center; }
  @keyframes rbBlink { 0%,92%,100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 95% { transform: scaleY(0.12); } }
  #floatRobot.angry .rb-hover { animation: rbShake 0.28s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes rbShake { 0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0) rotate(0)} 20%{transform:translate(-3px,1px) rotate(-5deg)} 60%{transform:translate(3px,-1px) rotate(5deg)} }
  #floatRobot .rb-normal-face { transition: opacity 0.15s; }
  #floatRobot .rb-angry-face { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.15s; }
  #floatRobot.angry .rb-normal-face { opacity: 0; }
  #floatRobot.angry .rb-angry-face { opacity: 1; }

  #floatRobotBubble {
    position: fixed; z-index: 201; max-width: 220px; width: max-content;
    background: var(--text); color: #052e20;
    font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35;
    padding: 9px 13px; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: scale(0.9);
    transition: opacity 0.25s var(--ease-out), transform 0.25s var(--ease-out);
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
  }
  #floatRobotBubble.show { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
  #floatRobotBubble.angry { background: var(--red); color: #fff; }
  #floatRobotBubble::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -6px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    border: 6px solid transparent; border-top-color: var(--text);
  }
  #floatRobotBubble.angry::after { border-top-color: var(--red); }

  /* Admin corner robot + summary panel */
  #adminRobot {
    position: fixed; width: 64px; height: 76px; z-index: 200;
    right: 28px; bottom: 28px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none;
    will-change: transform; filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4));
  }
  #adminRobot svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
  #adminRobotHint {
    position: fixed; right: 100px; bottom: 48px; z-index: 199;
    background: var(--text); color: #052e20; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600;
    padding: 7px 11px; border-radius: 10px; white-space: nowrap;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s; pointer-events: none;
    font-family: var(--font-ui);
  }
  #adminRobotHint.show { opacity: 1; }
  #adminRobotHint::after { content:''; position:absolute; right:-5px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); border:6px solid transparent; border-left-color: var(--text); }

  .arobot-overlay {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 400; background: rgba(2,8,5,0.55);
    backdrop-filter: blur(3px); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.25s;
  }
  .arobot-overlay.show { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
  .arobot-panel {
    position: fixed; right: 28px; bottom: 28px; z-index: 401;
    width: 460px; max-width: calc(100vw - 56px); max-height: 78vh; overflow-y: auto;
    background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border-bright);
    border-radius: 18px; padding: 22px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.97); opacity: 0; transition: transform 0.3s var(--ease-out), opacity 0.3s;
  }
  .arobot-overlay.show .arobot-panel { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  .arobot-panel h3 { font-size: 18px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0; color: var(--text); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .arobot-panel .ar-close { margin-left: auto; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; }
  .arobot-panel .ar-close:hover { color: var(--text); }
  .ar-section { margin-top: 18px; }
  .ar-section-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
  .ar-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 10px 12px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 11px; margin-bottom: 7px; }
  .ar-avatar { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .ar-card-main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .ar-card-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-display); }
  .ar-card-sub { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ar-card-right { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-align: right; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .ar-pill { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 100px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  .ar-load-idle { color: #8aa3b0; } .ar-load-light { color: var(--green); } .ar-load-busy { color: var(--amber); } .ar-load-over { color: var(--red); }
  .ar-empty { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic; padding: 8px 0; }

  .rate-input::-webkit-outer-spin-button, .rate-input::-webkit-inner-spin-button { -webkit-appearance: none; margin: 0; }
  .rate-input { -moz-appearance: textfield; }

  /* Fun leaderboard rankings */
  @keyframes sparkle { 0%,100% { filter: brightness(1); transform: scale(1); } 50% { filter: brightness(1.15); transform: scale(1.02); } }
  @keyframes auraGlow { 0%,100% { opacity: 0.92; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }
  @keyframes sigmaShift { 0%,100% { opacity: 0.85; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }
  @keyframes npcIdle { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(1px); } }
  @keyframes crownBounce { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(-3deg); } 50% { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(3deg); } }
  @keyframes goldShimmer { 0%,100% { background-position: 0% 50%; } 50% { background-position: 100% 50%; } }
  @keyframes ultimatePulse { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.005); } }
  @keyframes confettiFloat { 0% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; } 10% { opacity: 1; } 100% { transform: translateY(-40px) rotate(360deg); opacity: 0; } }
  @keyframes trophyBob { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } 50% { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.08); } }

  .rank-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.3px; margin-left: 6px; white-space: nowrap; will-change: filter, box-shadow, opacity; }
  .rank-giga { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.25), rgba(255,180,0,0.15)); color: var(--gold); animation: sparkle 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .rank-aura { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(180,140,255,0.2), rgba(140,100,255,0.1)); color: var(--purple); animation: auraGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .rank-sigma { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(74,158,255,0.2), rgba(40,120,255,0.1)); color: var(--blue); animation: sigmaShift 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .rank-npc { background: rgba(90,120,104,0.2); color: var(--text-muted); animation: npcIdle 6s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .crown { display: inline-block; animation: crownBounce 2s ease-in-out infinite; margin-right: 4px; }

  /* Team color dividers */
  .team-divider { font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; font-weight: 800; padding: 14px 4px 8px; margin-top: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-top: 1px dashed; }
  .team-divider:first-child { border-top: none; padding-top: 4px; margin-top: 0; }
  .team-divider-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }

  /* TEAM WINNING — Stage 1: simple gold (weeks 1-3) */
  .team-gold { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.08), rgba(255,180,0,0.03), rgba(255,215,0,0.08)); background-size: 200% 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.35) !important; animation: goldShimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .gold-trophy { display: inline-block; font-size: 18px; animation: trophyBob 2s ease-in-out infinite; }

  /* TEAM WINNING — Stage 3: ULTIMATE (day 16 results day) */
  .team-ultimate { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.2), rgba(255,180,0,0.08), rgba(255,215,0,0.2)); background-size: 200% 200%; border: 2px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.6) !important; animation: ultimatePulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite, goldShimmer 5s ease-in-out infinite; overflow: hidden; padding: 16px 14px !important; }
  .team-ultimate .ranking-name { font-size: 16px !important; font-weight: 800; }
  .team-ultimate .ranking-points { color: var(--gold) !important; font-size: 24px !important; }
  .ultimate-trophy { display: inline-block; font-size: 24px; animation: trophyBob 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; }

  /* Confetti for ultimate winner */
  .confetti-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; }
  .confetti-overlay span { position: absolute; font-size: 14px; opacity: 0; animation: confettiFloat 2s ease-out infinite; }
  .confetti-overlay span:nth-child(1) { left: 10%; animation-delay: 0s; }
  .confetti-overlay span:nth-child(2) { left: 30%; animation-delay: 0.4s; }
  .confetti-overlay span:nth-child(3) { left: 50%; animation-delay: 0.8s; }
  .confetti-overlay span:nth-child(4) { left: 70%; animation-delay: 1.2s; }
  .confetti-overlay span:nth-child(5) { left: 85%; animation-delay: 0.2s; }
  .confetti-overlay span:nth-child(6) { left: 20%; animation-delay: 1.6s; }

  /* Totals row clickable for admin */
  tr.totals-row.clickable td { cursor: pointer; }
  tr.totals-row.clickable:hover td { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.08); }
  .cell-empty { color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic; opacity: 0.6; }
  .status-cell { padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; }
  .status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; white-space: nowrap; }
  .status-pill::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }
  .status-assigned { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.15); color: var(--blue); }
  .status-progress { background: rgba(255,181,71,0.15); color: var(--amber); }
  .status-qc { background: rgba(180,140,255,0.15); color: var(--purple); }
  .status-revision { background: rgba(255,82,82,0.15); color: var(--red); }
  .status-done { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.15); color: var(--green); }
  .editor-cell { padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; }
  .editor-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 12px; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.08); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 100px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
  .editor-avatar { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-bright), var(--green-deep)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; color: #052e20; }
  .num-cell { padding: 12px 14px; cursor: text; font-weight: 600; }
  .revenue-val { color: var(--green-bright); }
  .fi-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-left:6px; padding:1px 5px; font-size:9px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.04em; background:rgba(29,168,116,0.15); color:#7ee2b8; border:1px solid rgba(29,168,116,0.4); border-radius:4px; vertical-align:middle; text-transform:lowercase; font-family:var(--font-ui); }
  .points-val { color: var(--amber); }
  .points-auto { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-left: 4px; font-weight: 500; }
  .points-manual { font-size: 9px; color: #ffce4a; margin-left: 5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; padding: 1px 5px; background: rgba(255,206,74,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(255,206,74,0.35); border-radius: 4px; text-transform: lowercase; vertical-align: middle; }
  tr.totals-row td { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.04); border-top: 2px solid var(--border-bright); font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.85; }
  tr.totals-row .cell { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
  .total-revenue { color: var(--green-bright); font-size: 15px; }
  .total-points { color: var(--amber); font-size: 15px; }
  .add-row-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border-top: 1px solid rgba(28,56,43,0.5); transition: all 0.15s; }
  .add-row-bar:hover { color: var(--green); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.03); }
  .row-delete { opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 16px; padding: 4px 8px; transition: all 0.15s; }
  tr:hover .row-delete { opacity: 0.6; }
  .row-delete:hover { opacity: 1 !important; color: var(--red); }
  .dropdown-menu { position: fixed; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border-bright); border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px; min-width: 200px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); z-index: 500; max-height: 320px; overflow-y: auto; }
  .dropdown-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; transition: background 0.12s; }
  .dropdown-item:hover { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.1); }
  .dropdown-item .item-edit { margin-left: auto; opacity: 0; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; padding: 2px 6px; }
  .dropdown-item:hover .item-edit { opacity: 1; }
  .dropdown-item .item-edit:hover { color: var(--green); }
  .dropdown-divider { height: 1px; background: var(--border); margin: 6px 4px; }
  .dropdown-add-input { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 6px; }
  .dropdown-add-input input { flex: 1; padding: 8px 10px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; }
  .dropdown-add-input button { padding: 0 12px; background: var(--green); color: #052e20; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; }
  .mini-calendar { position: fixed; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border-bright); border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; z-index: 500; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); width: 260px; }
  .cal-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .cal-header button { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.1); border: none; color: var(--green); width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; }
  .cal-month { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; }
  .cal-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 2px; }
  .cal-day-name { text-align: center; font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 4px 0; font-weight: 600; }
  .cal-day { text-align: center; padding: 7px 0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; transition: background 0.12s; }
  .cal-day:hover { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.1); }
  .cal-day.today { border: 1px solid var(--green); }
  .cal-day.selected { background: var(--green); color: #052e20; font-weight: 700; }
  .cal-day.empty { cursor: default; }
  .cal-clear { margin-top: 10px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; padding: 6px; }
  .cal-clear:hover { color: var(--red); }
  .rankings-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; }
  @media (max-width: 768px) { .rankings-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .ranking-block { background: rgba(13,31,24,0.5); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; padding: 22px; }
  .ranking-title { font-size: 12px; color: var(--green); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.2px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .ranking-title::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--green); border-radius: 50%; }
  .ranking-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
  .ranking-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 12px 14px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.4); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; transition: all 0.2s; }
  .ranking-row:hover { border-color: var(--border); }
  .ranking-row.me { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.06); border-color: rgba(94,231,176,0.2); }
  .rank-num { width: 30px; height: 30px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 50%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .rank-num.rank-1 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #f4c430); color: #2a1f00; }
  .rank-num.rank-2 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--silver), #909090); color: #1a1a1a; }
  .rank-num.rank-3 { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bronze), #8b5a2b); color: #2a1500; }
  .rank-num.other { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.08); color: var(--text-dim); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .ranking-name-wrap { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .ranking-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }
  .ranking-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 2px; }
  .ranking-points { font-weight: 800; font-size: 18px; color: var(--green); letter-spacing: -0.5px; }
  .empty-rank { text-align: center; padding: 24px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 13px; }
  .you-tag { font-size: 10px; color: var(--green); margin-left: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
  .ranking-section-label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; font-weight: 700; margin: 10px 0 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--border); }
  .locked-board { text-align: center; padding: 60px 24px; background: rgba(13,31,24,0.5); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; }
  .locked-icon { font-size: 48px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .locked-title { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .locked-sub { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 14px; }
  .modal-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); z-index: 600; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; }
  .modal-overlay.show { display: flex; }
  .modal { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; padding: 32px; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; max-height: 90vh; overflow-y: auto; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
  .modal h3 { font-size: 20px; margin-bottom: 8px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; }
  .modal-sub { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
  .modal-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .info-banner { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(94,231,176,0.15); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 16px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-dim); line-height: 1.5; }
  .team-section { padding: 16px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.4); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .team-section h4 { font-size: 13px; color: var(--green); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .members-list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .member-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 10px 5px 12px; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.08); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 100px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text); }
  .member-pill .leader-mark { font-size: 10px; color: var(--green); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.15); padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 100px; }
  .member-pill button { background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; padding: 0; transition: color 0.15s; }
  .member-pill button:hover { color: var(--red); }
  .add-member-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .add-member-row input { flex: 1; padding: 11px 14px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text); font-size: 14px; font-family: inherit; }
  .add-member-row button { padding: 0 16px; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.1); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--green); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; }
  .pwd-field { position: relative; flex: 1; }
  .pwd-field input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 44px 11px 14px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text); font-size: 14px; font-family: inherit; }
  .pwd-toggle { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; }
  .pwd-toggle:hover { color: var(--green); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.08); }
  .password-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin-top: 10px; }
  .password-row button { padding: 11px 16px; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.1); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--green); cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; font-family: inherit; white-space: nowrap; }
  .toast { position: fixed; bottom: 24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: rgba(13,31,24,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid var(--green-deep); color: var(--green); padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); z-index: 700; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s; pointer-events: none; }
  .toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px); }
  #loadingOverlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: var(--bg); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 9999; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
  .spin-mark { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; animation: pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; } 50% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: 0.85; } }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    body { padding: 12px; }
    .header { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
    .nav-tab { padding: 9px 14px; font-size: 12.5px; white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .nav-tabs { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; scrollbar-width: none; }
    .nav-tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
    .modal { padding: 20px 16px; border-radius: 16px; }
    .section-header { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }
    .toolbar select, .toolbar .btn-tb { min-height: 38px; }
  }

  /* FINANCE */
  .fin-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) { .fin-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .fin-card { background: rgba(13,31,24,0.5); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; }
  .fin-card h3 { font-size: 13px; color: var(--green); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .fin-stat { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,56,43,0.4); }
  .fin-stat:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .fin-stat .label { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 13px; }
  .fin-stat .val { font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; }
  .fin-stat .val.pos { color: var(--green); }
  .fin-stat .val.neg { color: var(--red); }
  .fin-stat .val.rev { color: var(--green-bright); }
  .fin-big { text-align: center; padding: 18px; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.05); border-radius: 12px; margin-top: 10px; }
  .fin-big .num { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -1.5px; }
  .fin-big .num.pos { color: var(--green); }
  .fin-big .num.neg { color: var(--red); }
  .fin-big .cap { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; font-weight: 700; margin-top: 4px; }

  .exp-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
  .exp-table th { text-align: left; font-size: 9px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.6px; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 6px 10px; font-weight: 700; opacity: 0.7; }
  .exp-table td { padding: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,56,43,0.3); }
  .exp-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
  .exp-cell { padding: 9px 10px; cursor: text; min-height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; font-size: 13px; }
  .exp-cell.empty { color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic; opacity: 0.5; }
  .exp-input { width: 100%; padding: 9px 10px; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.06); border: 1px solid var(--green); color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; outline: none; border-radius: 6px; }
  .exp-amount { color: var(--red); font-weight: 600; }
  .exp-del { opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; transition: all 0.15s; }
  tr:hover .exp-del { opacity: 0.5; }
  .exp-del:hover { opacity: 1 !important; color: var(--red); }
  .exp-add { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 10px; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px dashed rgba(28,56,43,0.6); border-radius: 8px; transition: all 0.15s; }
  .exp-add:hover { color: var(--green); border-color: var(--green-deep); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.04); }

  /* Distinct expense section cards */
  .exp-section {
    background: rgba(5,13,10,0.35);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .exp-section-head {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,56,43,0.5);
  }
  .exp-section-head .es-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .exp-section-head .es-icon { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 7px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; }
  .exp-section-head .es-total { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); }
  .exp-section.tint-regular .es-icon { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.12); }
  .exp-section.tint-food .es-icon { background: rgba(255,147,71,0.14); }
  .exp-section.tint-salary .es-icon { background: rgba(255,206,74,0.14); }
  .exp-section.tint-asset .es-icon { background: rgba(74,158,255,0.14); }
  .exp-section.tint-regular { border-left: 3px solid rgba(94,231,176,0.5); }
  .exp-section.tint-food { border-left: 3px solid rgba(255,147,71,0.5); }
  .exp-section.tint-salary { border-left: 3px solid rgba(255,206,74,0.5); }
  .exp-section.tint-asset { border-left: 3px solid rgba(74,158,255,0.5); }
  .exp-col-title { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 12px; opacity: 0.65; }
  .fin-bin-btn { font-size: 12px !important; padding: 8px 14px !important; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9px !important; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.5) !important; border: 1px solid var(--border) !important; color: var(--text-muted) !important; transition: all 0.15s; }
  .fin-bin-btn:hover { color: var(--text) !important; border-color: var(--green-deep) !important; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.05) !important; }

  /* Leads pipeline board */
  .leads-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 14px; padding-bottom: 20px; overflow-x: auto; }
  @media (max-width: 1400px) { .leads-board { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(240px, 1fr)); } }
  @media (max-width: 900px) { .leads-board { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .lead-col { min-height: 0; } .lead-empty-col { padding: 14px; } }

  /* Responsive 2-col grids (collapse on mobile) — used by expenses, lead editor, point calc */
  .grid-2col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  @media (max-width: 820px) { .grid-2col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  /* Hide floating mascots on phones — they cover content and touch has no cursor to dodge */
  @media (max-width: 768px), (pointer: coarse) {
    #floatRobot, #floatRobotBubble, #adminRobotHint { display: none !important; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    #adminRobot { width: 50px; height: 60px; right: 14px; bottom: 14px; }
    .arobot-panel { right: 12px; bottom: 12px; left: 12px; width: auto; max-width: none; }
    .lead-card-btn { padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px; }
    .lead-card { padding: 13px 14px; }
  }
  .lead-col {
    background: rgba(5,13,10,0.35); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 360px;
  }
  .lead-col.drag-over { border-color: var(--green); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.05); }
  .lead-col-head {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 4px 4px 12px; border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(28,56,43,0.6); margin-bottom: 10px;
  }
  .lead-col-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-display); text-transform: uppercase; }
  .lead-col-title .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }
  .lead-col-count { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; }
  .lead-col.stage-new .dot { background: #4a9eff; }
  .lead-col.stage-contacted .dot { background: #7ee2b8; }
  .lead-col.stage-followup .dot { background: #ffce4a; }
  .lead-col.stage-booked .dot { background: #a374ff; }
  .lead-col.stage-paid .dot { background: var(--green-bright); }
  .lead-col.stage-lost .dot { background: #ff5252; opacity: 0.6; }
  .lead-cards { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; }
  .lead-card {
    background: rgba(13,31,24,0.5); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 11px 12px; cursor: grab; transition: all 0.15s;
    position: relative;
  }
  .lead-card:hover { border-color: var(--green-deep); background: rgba(13,31,24,0.7); }
  .lead-card:active { cursor: grabbing; }
  .lead-card.dragging { opacity: 0.4; }
  .lead-card.overdue { border-color: rgba(255,82,82,0.5); background: rgba(255,82,82,0.06); }
  .lead-card.overdue::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -1px; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; width: 3px; background: #ff5252; border-radius: 3px; animation: leadPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes leadPulse { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }
  .lead-card.due-today { border-color: rgba(255,206,74,0.55); background: rgba(255,206,74,0.05); }
  .lead-card-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .lead-card-contact { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); word-break: break-all; }
  .lead-card-src { display: inline-block; margin-top: 6px; padding: 2px 7px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.1); color: #7ee2b8; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .lead-card-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px dashed rgba(28,56,43,0.5); font-size: 10px; }
  .lead-card-fu { color: var(--text-muted); }
  .lead-card-fu.warn { color: #ffce4a; font-weight: 700; }
  .lead-card-fu.overdue { color: #ff5252; font-weight: 700; }
  .lead-card-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
  .lead-card-btn {
    background: rgba(94,231,176,0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(94,231,176,0.25); color: #7ee2b8;
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }
  .lead-card-btn:hover { background: rgba(94,231,176,0.18); }
  .lead-card-btn.warn { background: rgba(255,82,82,0.06); border-color: rgba(255,82,82,0.3); color: #ff8a8a; }
  .lead-card-btn.warn:hover { background: rgba(255,82,82,0.15); }
  .lead-empty-col { text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 0.5; padding: 30px 12px; font-style: italic; }
  .lead-progress { height: 4px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-radius: 100px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 9px; }
  .lead-progress-fill { height: 100%; border-radius: 100px; transition: width 0.4s var(--ease-out); }
  .warm-badge { display: inline-block; margin-top: 7px; margin-left: 6px; padding: 3px 9px; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.03em; background: rgba(255,82,82,0.12); color: #ff8a8a; border: 1px solid rgba(255,82,82,0.35); border-radius: 100px; animation: leadPulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .warm-badge.today { background: rgba(255,206,74,0.1); color: #ffce4a; border-color: rgba(255,206,74,0.35); animation: none; }
  .lead-add-card {
    padding: 8px; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-muted);
    border: 1px dashed rgba(28,56,43,0.6); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s;
    margin-top: auto;
  }
  .lead-add-card:hover { color: var(--green); border-color: var(--green-deep); background: rgba(94,231,176,0.03); }

  /* Cards tinted to their column color */
  .lead-col.stage-new .lead-card { border-left: 3px solid #4a9eff; }
  .lead-col.stage-contacted .lead-card { border-left: 3px solid #7ee2b8; }
  .lead-col.stage-followup .lead-card { border-left: 3px solid #ffce4a; }
  .lead-col.stage-booked .lead-card { border-left: 3px solid #a374ff; }
  .lead-col.stage-paid .lead-card { border-left: 3px solid var(--green-bright); background: rgba(124,242,192,0.06); }
  .lead-col.stage-lost .lead-card { border-left: 3px solid #ff5252; opacity: 0.7; }
  /* overdue/due-today keep their stronger full highlight, overriding the tint */
  .lead-card.overdue { border-left-color: #ff5252 !important; }
  .lead-card.due-today { border-left-color: #ffce4a !important; }

  /* Paid celebration */
  #paidCelebration { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 900; pointer-events: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.35s; overflow: hidden; }
  #paidCelebration.show { opacity: 1; }
  #paidCelebration .paid-burst { text-align: center; transform: scale(0.6); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); }
  #paidCelebration.show .paid-burst { transform: scale(1); }
  #paidCelebration .paid-check { font-size: 68px; animation: paidPop 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1); }
  @keyframes paidPop { 0%{transform:scale(0) rotate(-30deg)} 100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0)} }
  #paidCelebration .paid-title { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--green-bright); font-family: var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin-top: 6px; text-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(124,242,192,0.4); }
  #paidCelebration .paid-name { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text); margin-top: 6px; font-weight: 600; }
  #paidCelebration .confetti { position: absolute; top: -20px; border-radius: 2px; animation: confettiFall linear forwards; }
  @keyframes confettiFall { 0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0);opacity:1} 100%{transform:translateY(105vh) rotate(720deg);opacity:0.9} }

  .tier-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 8px; }
  .tier-table th { text-align: left; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 6px 8px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }
  .tier-table td { padding: 7px 8px; font-size: 13px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(28,56,43,0.4); }
  .tier-table td.pts { color: var(--amber); font-weight: 700; text-align: right; }
  .tier-table td.rng { color: var(--green-bright); }

  .calc-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .calc-row input { flex: 1; padding: 12px 16px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text); font-size: 16px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 700; }
  .calc-row input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--green); }
  .calc-result { padding: 12px 18px; background: rgba(255,181,71,0.1); border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--amber); font-size: 18px; white-space: nowrap; }

  .split-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .split-name { width: 80px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; }
  .split-pct-input { width: 70px; padding: 8px 10px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; text-align: center; }
  .split-pct-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--green); }
  .split-amounts { margin-left: auto; text-align: right; }
  .split-rev-amt { color: var(--green-bright); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
  .split-profit-amt { color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; }
  .split-sub { font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-muted); }
  .split-warn { color: var(--amber); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 8px; }

  .report-box { background: rgba(5,13,10,0.5); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 18px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.9; }
  .report-line { color: var(--text-dim); }
  .report-line strong { color: var(--text); }
  .report-num { color: var(--green-bright); font-weight: 700; }
  .report-num.pts { color: var(--amber); }
  .report-num.neg { color: var(--red); }
  .notes-area { width: 100%; min-height: 120px; padding: 14px; background: rgba(94,231,176,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(94,231,176,0.25); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--green-bright); font-size: 14px; font-family: inherit; line-height: 1.6; resize: vertical; margin-top: 12px; }
  .notes-area:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--green); }
  .notes-label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--green); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; font-weight: 700; }

  .split-taka { color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; margin-top: 2px; }
  .rate-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--border); flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .rate-label { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-weight: 600; }
  .rate-eq { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight: 600; }
  .rate-input { width: 80px; padding: 7px 10px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--green-bright); font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; }
  .rate-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--green); }
  .converter { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 12px; margin: 16px 0; }
  .conv-side { flex: 1; }
  .conv-side label { display: block; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .conv-side input { width: 100%; padding: 11px 14px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--text); font-size: 15px; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 700; }
  .conv-side input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--green); }
  .conv-eq { font-size: 18px; color: var(--green); padding-bottom: 10px; }
  .collapse-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; }
  .collapse-arrow { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px; }
  .tier-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin: 16px 0 8px; }
  .tier-input { width: 100%; padding: 7px 9px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.6); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; font-family: inherit; }
  .tier-input.pts { color: var(--amber); font-weight: 700; }
  .tier-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--green); }
  .tier-note { font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 8px; font-style: italic; }
  .rate-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .rate-bar-input { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }

  /* Drag and drop settings */
  .dnd-arena { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }
  .dnd-zone { border: 2px dashed; border-radius: 14px; padding: 14px; min-height: 80px; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; }
  .dnd-zone.dnd-over { border-style: solid; filter: brightness(1.15); }
  .dnd-zone-title { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .dnd-members { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; }
  .dnd-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; background: rgba(5,13,10,0.5); border: 1px solid; border-radius: 100px; font-size: 13px; cursor: grab; transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s; user-select: none; }
  .dnd-pill:active { cursor: grabbing; transform: scale(1.04); }
  .drag-handle { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 14px; cursor: grab; }
  .dnd-name { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
  .dnd-remove { background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; font-size: 16px; padding: 0 2px; line-height: 1; transition: color 0.15s; }
  .dnd-remove:hover { color: var(--red); }
  .leader-star { cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-muted); transition: color 0.15s; }
  .leader-star.active { color: var(--gold); }
  .leader-star:hover { color: var(--gold); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="loadingOverlay"><div class="spin-mark"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="A" style="width:34px;height:auto"></div><div id="loadingText" style="color:var(--text-dim);font-size:13px">Connecting to cloud...</div></div>

<div id="loginScreen" class="login-screen" style="display:none">
  <div class="login-card">
    <div class="login-brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="AR Studioss" style="width:72px;height:72px;border-radius:var(--radius-md);margin:0 auto;display:block"></div>
    <div class="role-tabs">
      <div class="role-tab active" data-role="client" onclick="switchRole('client')">Client</div>
      <div class="role-tab" data-role="editor" onclick="switchRole('editor')">Editor</div>
      <div class="role-tab" data-role="admin" onclick="switchRole('admin')">Admin</div>
    </div>
    <div id="adminLogin" style="display:none"><div class="form-group"><label>Password</label><input type="password" id="adminPass" placeholder="Enter admin password"></div></div>
    <div id="editorLogin" style="display:none">
      <div id="editorSignIn">
        <div class="form-group"><label>Name</label><input type="text" id="editorName" placeholder="Your editor name" autocomplete="username"></div>
        <div class="form-group"><label>Password</label><input type="password" id="editorPass" placeholder="Enter password" autocomplete="current-password"></div>
        <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:14px;text-align:center">Need an account? Ask the admin.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="clientLogin">
      <div id="clientSignIn">
        <div class="form-group"><label>Brand / Company Name</label><input type="text" id="clientName" placeholder="Your brand name" autocomplete="username"></div>
        <div class="form-group"><label>Password</label><input type="password" id="clientPass" placeholder="Enter password" autocomplete="current-password"></div>
        <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:14px;text-align:center">Need an account? Contact us to get set up.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" id="mainSignInBtn" onclick="login()" style="width:100%;padding:13px">Sign in</button>
    <div id="loginError" class="error-msg">Wrong credentials. Try again.</div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="mainApp" class="container" style="display:none">
  <div class="header">
    <div class="logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="AR Studioss" style="height:30px;width:auto;display:block"></div>
    <div class="header-right">
      <span id="userBadge" class="user-badge"></span>
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="openRecycleBin()" id="recycleBinBtn">🗑 Bin</button>
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="openSettings()">⚙ Settings</button>
      <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="logout()">Sign out</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="nav-tabs" id="navTabs">
    <div class="nav-tab active" data-page="crm" onclick="switchPage('crm')">📋 Editors</div>
    <div class="nav-tab" data-page="clients" onclick="switchPage('clients')" id="clientsTab" style="display:none">🤝 Clients</div>
    <div class="nav-tab" data-page="leaderboard" onclick="switchPage('leaderboard')">🏆 Leaderboard</div>
    <div class="nav-tab" data-page="finance" onclick="switchPage('finance')" id="financeTab">💰 Finance</div>
    <div class="nav-tab" data-page="leads" onclick="switchPage('leads')" id="leadsTab" style="display:none">🎯 Leads</div>
  </div>

  <div class="page active" id="page-crm">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div><div class="section-title">Editor CRM</div><div class="section-sub" id="crmPeriodLabel"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="toolbar">
      <div class="toolbar-group">
        <span class="toolbar-label">Period</span>
        <select id="crmYear" class="tb-select" onchange="changeYearMonth('crm')"></select>
      </div>
      <div class="toolbar-group">
        <select id="crmMonthSel" class="tb-select" onchange="changeYearMonth('crm')" style="padding-left:14px"></select>
      </div>
      <div class="toolbar-group">
        <span class="toolbar-label">Sort</span>
        <select id="crmSort" class="tb-select" onchange="renderCRM()">
          <option value="none">Default</option>
          <option value="editor">Editor (A-Z)</option>
          <option value="status">Status</option>
          <option value="deadline">Deadline</option>
          <option value="revenue">Revenue ↓</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="toolbar-group">
        <span class="toolbar-label">Editor</span>
        <select id="crmFilterEditor" class="tb-select" onchange="renderCRM()"><option value="">All</option></select>
      </div>
      <div class="toolbar-group">
        <span class="toolbar-label">Status</span>
        <select id="crmFilterStatus" class="tb-select" onchange="renderCRM()">
          <option value="">All</option>
          <option value="Assigned">Assigned</option>
          <option value="In Progress">In Progress</option>
          <option value="In QC">In QC</option>
          <option value="Need Revision">Need Revision</option>
          <option value="Done">Done</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <button class="btn-tb" onclick="addColumn()" id="addColBtn">＋ Column</button>
    </div>
    <div class="table-wrap" id="crmFlatWrap">
      <table class="crm"><thead><tr id="crmHead"></tr></thead><tbody id="crmBody"></tbody></table>
      <div class="add-row-bar" id="addRowBar" onclick="addRow()">＋ <span id="addRowLabel">Add row</span></div>
    </div>
    <div id="crmGroupedWrap" style="display:none"></div>
    <div id="teamPulseWrap" style="display:none;margin-top:24px"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="page" id="page-clients">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div><div class="section-title" id="clientsTitle">Clients</div><div class="section-sub" id="clientsSub"></div></div>
    </div>
    <div id="clientsContent"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="page" id="page-leaderboard">
    <div class="section-header"><div><div class="section-title">Leaderboard</div><div class="section-sub" id="lbPeriodLabel"></div></div></div>
    <div id="leaderboardContent"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="page" id="page-finance">
    <div class="section-header"><div><div class="section-title">Finance</div><div class="section-sub" id="financePeriodLabel"></div></div></div>
    <div class="toolbar">
      <span class="toolbar-label">Period:</span>
      <select id="finYear" onchange="changeYearMonth('finance')"></select>
      <select id="finMonthSel" onchange="changeYearMonth('finance')"></select>
    </div>
    <div id="financeContent"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="page" id="page-leads">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div>
        <div class="section-title">Leads Pipeline</div>
        <div class="section-sub">Drag cards between stages · Bump follow-up dates to keep prospects warm</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openLeadEditor()" style="margin-left:auto">＋ Add Lead</button>
    </div>
    <div id="leadsContent"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="settingsModal">
  <div class="modal" style="max-width:560px">
    <h3 id="settingsTitle">Settings</h3><p class="modal-sub" id="settingsSub"></p>
    <div id="settingsBody"></div>
    <div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeModal('settingsModal')">Done</button></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="confirmModal">
  <div class="modal" style="max-width:400px">
    <h3 id="confirmTitle">Confirm</h3><p class="modal-sub" id="confirmMessage"></p>
    <div class="modal-actions">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeModal('confirmModal')">Cancel</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" id="confirmActionBtn">Confirm</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="recycleBinModal">
  <div class="modal" style="max-width:640px">
    <h3>🗑 Recycle Bin</h3>
    <p class="modal-sub">Deleted rows are kept for 45 days. Click Restore to bring a row back.</p>
    <div id="recycleBinModalContent" style="margin-top:16px;max-height:60vh;overflow-y:auto"></div>
    <div class="modal-actions" style="margin-top:16px">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeModal('recycleBinModal')">Close</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="pointCalcModal">
  <div class="modal" style="max-width:480px">
    <h3>🧮 Point Calculator</h3>
    <p class="modal-sub">Define the project to get its points on our scale</p>
    <div id="pointCalcBody" style="margin-top:16px"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="modal-overlay" id="namedLinksModal">
  <div class="modal" style="max-width:440px">
    <h3>Raw Footage</h3>
    <p class="modal-sub">Add project names with their links</p>
    <div id="namedLinksList" style="margin:16px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px"></div>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px">
      <input type="text" id="nlName" placeholder="Project name" style="flex:1;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;background:rgba(5,13,10,0.5);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font-ui)">
      <input type="text" id="nlUrl" placeholder="Paste link" style="flex:1;padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;background:rgba(5,13,10,0.5);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;color:var(--text);font-family:var(--font-ui)">
      <button class="btn-tb" onclick="nlAddEntry()" style="padding:10px 14px;white-space:nowrap">＋</button>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-actions">
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="nlSave()" style="width:100%">Done</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="toast" class="toast"></div>
